name: repopilot
description: Snapshot each session and review what the agent changed before it stops: tests it skipped, focused, removed, or weakened, broken local callers, new lint/type suppressions, relaxed CI gates, removed auth checks, and untrusted input reaching SQL, shell, or path sinks. Deterministic and local; requires the repopilot CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Stops the agent when it weakens tests, breaks local callers, adds suppressions, or opens risky sinks. Local and deterministic.
